institutions.display_name: EXAMPLE-ONLY -- no real institution has been assigned to this manifest

process_notes: One representative program per institution (default: undergraduate Computer Science), per the pipeline skill's scope-discipline rule, unless a batch is explicitly defined with a different scope.
Every institution in a batch runs the full seven-phase pipeline independently; one institution's CONFLICT or blocked source never stalls another's run.
Canonical IDs are assigned before research begins to prevent cross-institution ID collisions being discovered mid-batch (see batch-spec.md step 1).
HUMAN_REVIEW -> APPROVED still requires Suhail's explicit sign-off, per institution, per record -- batching changes nothing about this gate.
This manifest's 'status' fields are the only per-run state a batch manifest needs to track at this design stage; a real implementation may add per-phase timestamps once a batch actually begins.

aggregate_qa_rollup._comment: Populated only after every institution in the batch reaches 04-verification -- see batch-output-contract.md for the exact shape.
